Cache retains narrative event state only. Projection version 4 rebuilds historical facts; every task narrative request assembles current plan state and calls inspectTaskDeliverables again. Unchanged event watermark does not reuse previous filesystem observation.
confirmedBoundaries.evidence: Source review plus final independent cases 1 and 2.

confirmedBoundaries.claim: History is recorded_assertion and always incomplete, not an archive of old bytes or creator attribution. Invalid metadata/snapshot/thread/path/revision cannot become current binding; exact current revision requirement is intentionally conservative after other plan changes.

File observation is limited to 64 candidate checks, at most 64 path segments, 8 MiB per file and 32 MiB read bytes in total. Native descriptor/path identity, size, mtime and ctime are checked. Symlink, FIFO/non-file, unsupported kind, exhausted budget, unstable and unreadable observations stay unchecked.
confirmedBoundaries.evidence: Read final v3/v4 implementation and owner exact-byte-growth regression; these filesystem boundary tests were not independently rerun in this review.

confirmedBoundaries.claim: Current identity selection no longer lets a late update of an older artifact reclaim a newer generation. It uses artifact createdAt, plan createdAt and stable declaration order for same-clock ties; mutable update time does not select generation.
confirmedBoundaries.evidence: Reviewed final v4 source; root discovered the original compatibility counterexample and owner reports final generation regressions. This review did not independently rerun that test.
